npc.runecraftory.chef.1.dating_accept.1: Wait, really?! Oh, that's wonderful! I suppose I've been so busy dreaming up new recipes that I never noticed you sneaking into my thoughts. Yes, %player%! I'd love to be with you!
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.dating_accept.2: Oh my! You've certainly caught me by surprise! But now that you mention it, I think spending time with you has become one of my favorite things. I'd love to give this a try!
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.dating_accept.3: You know, I've always believed that the best things happen when you mix two unexpected ingredients. Perhaps we're a little like that! Yes, I'd love to be with you!
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.dating_deny.1: Oh! That's quite a surprise! I'm really flattered, but I don't think my feelings are quite the same. I hope we can still share a few meals together!
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.dating_deny.2: You're wonderful, %player%, but I think we're better as friends. I wouldn't want to spoil the lovely thing we already have.
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.dating_deny.3: Oh goodness! I wasn't expecting that. I'm afraid I don't feel that kind of spark, but I do enjoy having you around!
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.default_gift.1: Oh! Something for me? How exciting! Thank you! I wonder what I could do with this... Inspiration can come from the strangest places!
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.dislike.1: Oh, thank you! It's not exactly something I'd get excited about, but I suppose I could find a little use for it.
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.divorce.1: Oh... I see. I suppose not every combination turns out the way you hoped. I wish things had been different, %player%. I'll always remember the good times we shared.
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.divorce.2: So our little adventure comes to an end... That's a shame. I really thought we had a wonderful recipe for happiness. Take care of yourself, alright?
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.divorce.3: I understand. Sometimes even the best ingredients don't make the perfect dish. I won't hold you back, but I'll miss having you around.
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.divorce_error.1: Divorce? But we haven't even gotten married! That's like trying to serve a cake before you've even mixed the ingredients!
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.divorce_error.2: Oh! I think you've skipped a rather important step there. We need to be married before we can get divorced, silly!
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.divorce_error.3: Huh? Already ending things? But I don't remember us ever starting a marriage! Did I miss something while experimenting in the kitchen?
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.first.1: Ah! A new face! Welcome, welcome! I'm %npc%, the local cook. Always looking for new ingredients, fresh ideas, and brave souls willing to try my latest creations! Don't worry, I haven't set the kitchen on fire today... yet.
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.first.2: Oh, hello there! I'm %npc%. I spend most of my days cooking up all sorts of wonderful things. Well, wonderful might be a matter of opinion, but that's part of the fun! You should stop by sometime!
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.first.3: Greetings, hungry traveler! I'm %npc%, and I happen to be rather passionate about food. Cooking is an art, you know! A little imagination, a pinch of courage, and perhaps a questionable ingredient or two. That's how great recipes are born!
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.first.4: Well, hello! Have you eaten yet? No? Perfect! I'm %npc%, the local cook. I'm always looking for someone to test my newest recipes. You look like you have a strong stomach. Excellent!
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.follow_no.1: Oh, what a shame! I've got a few recipes to experiment with anyway. Perhaps next time!
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.follow_no.2: Not today, I'm afraid. I've got an idea I simply must try before I forget it!
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.follow_no.3: Aww, I'd love to, but the kitchen is calling! And when inspiration strikes, you simply cannot ignore it.
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.follow_stop.1: Already heading back? Oh well! I've got plenty of ideas to write down before I forget them.
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.follow_stop.2: That was fun! I wonder if I could turn some of our discoveries into a new dish...
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.follow_stop.3: Back to the kitchen for me! I've suddenly got a rather brilliant idea. At least, I think it's brilliant...
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.follow_talk.1: Oh, %player%! Do you think we'll find anything edible around here? I've been having some rather interesting recipe ideas lately.
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.follow_talk.2: I wonder what would happen if I cooked something over a campfire instead of a proper stove. Hmm... perhaps I should experiment later.
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.follow_talk.3: You know, adventures are a wonderful source of inspiration. New places, new ingredients, new flavors! This is almost as exciting as being in my kitchen.
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.follow_yes.1: An adventure?! Wonderful! I wonder what strange ingredients we'll find along the way. This could be the beginning of a brilliant new recipe!
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.follow_yes.2: Absolutely! A little change of scenery might inspire me. Besides, I've been meaning to collect some unusual ingredients.
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.follow_yes.3: Count me in! I'll bring some snacks. Every good adventure needs proper food, after all!
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.greeting.1: Oh, %player%! Just the person I wanted to see! I've been working on something rather unusual. Tell me, how do you feel about mixing sweet and spicy?
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.greeting.2: Well, well! It's my favorite adventurer! Have you brought back anything interesting? Something edible, preferably... although I'm open to surprises!
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.greeting.3: Hello again! I had the strangest idea for a new recipe this morning. Something involving mushrooms, berries, and... never mind, you'll have to try it yourself!
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.greeting.4: Ah, there you are! Perfect timing. I was just wondering what I should cook today. Perhaps something with a little more excitement than ordinary stew?
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.hate.1: Oh dear... what an unfortunate choice. I can't imagine doing anything interesting with this, and that's saying something coming from me.
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.like.1: Ohhh! Now this is exciting! I can already think of a dozen wonderful things I could do with this. Thank you, %player%!
Marriage?! Oh, that's absolutely wonderful! Just imagine all the meals we'll share, all the recipes we'll invent, and all the memories we'll make! Yes, %player%! A thousand times yes!
Oh, you've made me happier than a perfectly risen loaf of bread! I can't imagine a better person to share my life with. Of course I'll marry you!
A lifetime together? What a marvelous idea! I promise to keep surprising you with new dishes, strange experiments, and plenty of love. I accept!
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.marriage_deny.1: Oh, that's such a lovely thought! But marriage is a rather big recipe, and I don't think I've gathered all the ingredients just yet. Could we take a little more time?
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.marriage_deny.2: You're making me blush! I care about you very much, but I don't want to rush into something so important. I hope you understand.
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.marriage_deny.3: Oh my... that's quite a question! I think I'd like to spend a little more time discovering what the future holds before making such a promise.
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.procreation_cool: Hehe, let's not rush things! Even the best recipes need time to come together. How about we enjoy something delicious together instead?
Oh, not just yet! I've got a few other ideas I'd like to explore with you first. There's no need to hurry!
Mmm... I think we should take a little break. Perhaps a nice dinner together? I have a new recipe I'd love for you to try!
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.talk.1: I've always wondered why people are so afraid of unusual food combinations. Chocolate and chili, honey and herbs, mushrooms with sweet berries... There are so many possibilities! Though I admit, not every experiment has been a success.
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.talk.2: Sometimes I imagine opening a restaurant in a faraway kingdom. A place where every dish tells a story, and every meal is a little adventure. Maybe I'll make that dream come true someday!
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.talk.3: Did you know that some of the best recipes are discovered by accident? I once dropped a handful of berries into a pot of stew. It was... interesting. Very interesting. Let's just say the villagers haven't forgotten it.
npc.runecraftory.chef.1.talk.4: I think cooking is a lot like magic. You take a bunch of ordinary ingredients, mix them together, and suddenly you've created something entirely new! Except sometimes the magic goes horribly wrong.
